newsitem.title: USA: Bank NY Q3 credit card charge-off of $86 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bank NY Q3 credit card charge-off of $86 mln.

text.p: The Bank of New York on Tuesday reported that its net charge-offs of credit card loans rose to $86 million for the third quarter when compared with $70 million in the second quarter.
The third quarter figure was reported on a pro-forma basis and excluded the impact of the bank's sale of its portfolio for the AFL-CIO Union Priviledge credit card.

The bank said on the same basis, net charge-offs and accounts delinquent for more than 30 days were 6.34 percent and 6.48 percent in the third quarter, compared with 5.29 percent and 5.54 percent in the second quarter.
Credit card loans outstanding were $5.348 billion at September 30 compared with $5.508 billion at June 30, 1996, the bank said.
